verdict.rationale: Postman offers pieces of event-driven automation — webhooks for event-driven integrations, pre-request/post-response scripts that run automatically on request/response events, and CLI-driven CI/CD triggers — but there's no documented general-purpose 'rule engine' where a user defines arbitrary event→action rules across the platform. Missing for 10: a dedicated rules/trigger builder (e.g., 'if event X occurs, run action Y' across collections/workspaces), independent/hands-on confirmation of webhook-triggered automation actually working, and evidence of AI-native rule definition (vs. Agent Mode's conversational actions).
